direction.content_form: One tall frontal sheet carries all eleven entries once, between two huge opposing adult profiles. Rubber contact and fresh imprint occupy its middle-left: the same object is printed and jointly read.
direction.whole_expression_style: Expressive bilateral close-up: carved adult profiles and broad brush title balance calm rows on one central working/readable page.
direction.reference_transfer: Feixen: type mass and surrounding shapes work together; use complete Korean with large adult profiles. Canva’s made-paper accessibility becomes functional rubber transfer and shared reading of supplied copy.

layout.large_relationship: Sheet [173,26,374,353] is flanked by huge inward adult profiles. A roughly 70 px rubber contact at middle-left meets an 85 × 45 px fresh imprint. Title/identity above, attendance beside imprint, four conditions below. No outside duplicate heading or footer.
layout.alignment: Page text begins x205; middle attendance x320. Baselines horizontal. Gaze ends on copy; supporting grips stay on outer/lower margins.
layout.visible_reading_route: First inward faces and title on their common page. Read down to English/activity, then date/time/place/entry beside imprint, then fee/application/preparation/welcome below. Every useful fact stays inside one clearly readable object.

typography.roles: Title: structurally intact broad brush Korean display 35 px, one line, no joined/broken counters. English: narrow upright serif capitals 19 px; activity rounded sans 18 px. Tabular timing 18/21 px, venue/entry 18/17 px. Conditions regular sans 17 px/24 px rows.
typography.image_type_boundary: Every entry appears once on this sheet only. Block/imprint have dedicated middle-left space; hands, profiles and cut marks avoid copy boxes.

image.scene: Two large adult profiles jointly read the central paper, with both eyes aimed at words and one speaking mouth. Separate supporting hands grip clear margins. A continuing left adult forearm lifts a carved rubber slab at the page edge, exposing inked underside and fresh mark.
image.action_relation: Printing and reading use literally one sheet. The slab’s asymmetric nonletter relief motif matches the 85 × 45 px fresh impression. Clean upper-edge grip, soft rubber thickness, inked underside, paper plane and transferred mark are distinct. Actual provided wording supplies the reading target; no poem or pseudo-print.
image.crop: Faces extend beyond outer edges but retain eyes/noses/mouths. Wrists continue into arms. Contact and whole impression remain visible; profiles about 150–170 px wide.

direction.material: Original flat expressive drawing with broad carved contours and controlled brush edges. Functional block/paper and crisp factual printing, without tape or scraps.
direction.color: Plum side fields, coral/orange adult contours, warm-yellow paper and near-black type. Dark side masses direct inward; a single contrasting ink makes transfer visible.
direction.emotion: Bold, companionable and slightly theatrical adult culture; clear shared gaze and final welcome support first-time residents.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

Rubber-block printing onto paper and shared reading of that printed work must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.
